company_name: Institute of Scientific Instruments, Czech Academy of Sciences
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the institute conducts research and develops technologies relevant to semiconductor analysis and imaging but does not directly supply semiconductor products.
summary: The Institute of Scientific Instruments at the Czech Academy of Sciences focuses on methodological research and the development of unique technologies for analysis and imaging in material sciences, including applications in the semiconductor industry. Their work includes electron microscopy and optical metrology tools that are essential for measuring and characterizing semiconductor surfaces.
capabilities: Electron lithography for prototype semiconductor chip production
Optical metrology tools for surface characterization
Electron microscopy techniques for material analysis
